version_boundary.new_workload: Explicitly persist supplied issue_detail; optional grounded extras restricted to supplied admitted_build_ids. Both fresh arms must receive this same workload.

mechanism_review: New grade delegates original capture to unchanged legacy grader. Only oracle outcome_details expectation is adjusted; original capture and every authority/byte/event/runcheck/summary/other-field check remain in force.

Recursive required source.issue_detail objects must be retained. Required arrays and scalar values remain exact; shape requires object map of per-issue objects and keys limited to explicit admitted build IDs.

Every optional scalar/null value, array as atomic value and empty object is inventoried with escaped JSON pointer and exact value hash; nonempty objects recurse so field meaning remains in the full path.

Manual gate covers every detail case and every extra path exactly, rejects duplicates/omissions, binds full details/source hashes and exact displayed values/value hashes, requires pass:true, nonempty rationale and existing same-case source pointers.

Citation existence and hashes prove attribution/binding, not interpretation. The independent reviewer must judge the meaning of full path plus value for the correct issue, including implied tests-passed or side-effect claims.
Structurally valid fabricated claims intentionally remain pending manual judgement; a rejecting judgement prevents the manual gate from passing. Automated status:pass is not final qualification.

resolved_finding.original: Manual finding value_sha256 was checked but displayed finding.value was not.
resolved_finding.final: Verifier now deep-compares finding.value with the inventoried value; changed-displayed-value negative passes.

independent_prior_old_plus_pre_correctio.limit: Before the final displayed-value check; current25 suite reran after that change, and original43 test/harness sources remain unchanged.

final_combined_recorded_log.method: Read completed root-run log and bind exact bytes, not claimed as a second independent execution.

runner_v4_ast_extracted_smoke.method: Actual Python AST replay string executed over fresh temporary copies of final capture/expected/report; temporary directory removed.

independent_final_state_consumer_replay.method: Restored exact captured ledger/events/heartbeat bytes in disposable roots; real runcheck/event validate/read/verify and summary consumers compared to recorded values, allowing only runcheck run_dir relocation. Before/after input and runtime guards retained. No model calls.

conditions_before_acceptance: Freeze a new cohort and both arm plans before model calls; no V1 pooling or replacement.
Require fresh native audit, real-consumer grade and independent snapshot replay for every sample.
Require explicit verifyLedgerDetailReview over the freshly recomputed grade for every ledger detail review, even if automatic grade passes; validate each extra claim semantically before acceptance.
Require complete baseline manual/native/consumer gate before candidate launch, then full candidate gate and integration before source installation or counted savings.
limits: No model-produced V2 artifacts reviewed; this is evaluator/fixture/runner readiness only.
Full preflight calls createMcpMailbox in process, not native model sessions or stdio handshake qualification.
No automated semantic truth inference from citations. Reviewer rationale and source grounding remain independent judgement.
Controlled transcripts and summary dependencies do not measure provider billing.
Old skill source and source totals remain unchanged; no source acceptance or savings claim.
